<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const tabLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.links .btn');
    const tabContents = document.querySelectorAll('.right_img .tab_content');

    tabLinks.forEach((link) => {
      link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();

        const classList = Array.from(this.classList);
        const targetClass = classList.find(c => c.startsWith('link-lists'));
        if (!targetClass) return;
        const index = targetClass.replace('link-lists', '');

        tabLinks.forEach(item => {
          const originalStyle = item.getAttribute('data-btn-class');

          item.classList.remove('active', 'primary');

          if (originalStyle) {
            item.classList.add(originalStyle);
          }
        });

        tabContents.forEach(content => content.classList.remove('active'));

        const currentOriginalStyle = this.getAttribute('data-btn-class');
        if (currentOriginalStyle) {
          this.classList.remove(currentOriginalStyle);
        }
        this.classList.add('active', 'primary');

        const matchingContent = document.querySelector('.tab_content' + index);
        if (matchingContent) {
          matchingContent.classList.add('active');
        }
      });
    });
  });
</script></div>

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const sliders = document.querySelectorAll('.testimonials_slider');


    function updateBodybackground(slide) {
      const wrapper = document.querySelector('.testimonials_stats');
      if (!slide) return;

      const colorValue = slide.dataset.attr;

      if (colorValue) {

        if (colorValue.startsWith('#')) {
          const r = parseInt(colorValue.slice(1, 3), 16);
          const g = parseInt(colorValue.slice(3, 5), 16);
          const b = parseInt(colorValue.slice(5, 7), 16);

          wrapper.style.backgroundColor = `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, 0.20)`;
        } else {

          wrapper.style.backgroundColor = colorValue;
          wrapper.style.opacity = "0.20"; 
        }

        wrapper.style.transition = "background-color 0.8s ease";

      }
    }

    sliders.forEach((sliderElement) => {
      const updateWrapperColor = () => {
        const wrapper = sliderElement.closest('.testimonials_stats');
        const activeSlide = sliderElement.querySelector('.glide__slide--active');

        if (wrapper && activeSlide) {
          const colorValue = activeSlide.dataset.attr;
          if (colorValue) {

            if (colorValue.startsWith('#')) {
              const r = parseInt(colorValue.slice(1, 3), 16);
              const g = parseInt(colorValue.slice(3, 5), 16);
              const b = parseInt(colorValue.slice(5, 7), 16);

              wrapper.style.backgroundColor = `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, 0.20)`;
            } else {

              wrapper.style.backgroundColor = colorValue;
              wrapper.style.opacity = "0.20"; 
            }

            wrapper.style.transition = "background-color 0.8s ease";

          }
        }
      };

      const glide = new Glide(sliderElement, {
        type: 'carousel',
        startAt: 0,
        perView: 1,
        gap: 10,
        autoplay: 0
      });

      let sliderVisible = false;

      const animateCounters = (activeSlide) => {
        const counters = activeSlide.querySelectorAll('.count');
        const duration = 2000;

        counters.forEach(counter => {
          const target = parseInt(counter.dataset.number.replace(/,/g, ''), 10);
          const numSpan = counter.querySelector('.count-num');
          const startTime = performance.now();

          const update = (now) => {
            const elapsed = now - startTime;
            const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);

            const ease = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 2);
            const current = Math.round(target * ease);

            if (numSpan) {
              numSpan.textContent = current.toLocaleString();
            }

            if (progress < 1) {
              requestAnimationFrame(update);
            }
          };

          requestAnimationFrame(update);
        });
      };

      const runCounterAnimation = () => {
        if (!sliderVisible) return;

        const activeSlide = sliderElement.querySelector('.glide__slide--active');

        if (activeSlide) {
          activeSlide.querySelectorAll('.count-num').forEach(el => {
            el.textContent = '0';
          });

          animateCounters(activeSlide);
        }
      };

      const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            sliderVisible = true;
            runCounterAnimation();
          } else {
            sliderVisible = false;
          }
        });
      }, {
        threshold: 0.4
      });

      observer.observe(sliderElement);
      const addBulletsClass = () => {
        let bullets = [
          ...sliderElement.querySelectorAll(".glide__bullets .glide__bullet")
        ];

        // wait until active class exists
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {

          let currentIndex = bullets.findIndex(bullet =>
                                               bullet.classList.contains("glide__bullet--active")
                                              );

          if (currentIndex === -1) return;

          bullets.forEach(b => b.classList.remove("near-active"));

          if (currentIndex === 0) {
            bullets[1]?.classList.add("near-active");
            bullets[2]?.classList.add("near-active");

          } else if (currentIndex === bullets.length - 1) {
            bullets[currentIndex - 1]?.classList.add("near-active");
            bullets[currentIndex - 2]?.classList.add("near-active");

          } else {
            bullets[currentIndex - 1]?.classList.add("near-active");
            bullets[currentIndex + 1]?.classList.add("near-active");
          }

        });
      };

      glide.on('mount.after', () => {

        updateWrapperColor();
        addBulletsClass()
      });




      glide.on('run.after', () => {
        runCounterAnimation();
        addBulletsClass();

      });

      glide.on('run.before', () => {
        const slides = document.querySelectorAll(
          '.testimonials_stats .glide__slide:not(.glide__slide--clone)'
        );

        const currentIndex = glide.index;
        const total = slides.length;

        const nextIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % total;
        const nextSlide = slides[nextIndex];
        updateBodybackground(nextSlide)

      });

      glide.mount();

      // Retirer les vidéos des clones Glide (évite les lecteurs en double)
      sliderElement.querySelectorAll('.glide__slide--clone .testimonials_stats_image.has_video')
        .forEach(function (el) {
          var v = el.querySelector('.testimonials_video_native');
          if (v) { v.pause(); v.removeAttribute('src'); v.load(); v.remove(); }
          el.classList.remove('has_video');
        });
    });
  });
</script>

  function resume() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.testimonials_video_native').forEach(function (v) {

      v.loop = true;
      if (v.paused && v.isConnected) {

    if (!document.hidden) setTimeout(resume, 100);
  });
  window.addEventListener('pageshow', function () { setTimeout(resume, 100); });
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', resume);
})();
</script>
